name: com.ps2cc.importer
description: Imports PS2CC character exports: Humanoid avatar from humanoid_map.json, PS2 URP shaders (PS2/Skin, PS2/Cutout, PS2/Cloth, PS2/Grade) with the app's light model, the PS2Look component for .ps2look files, materials from the .ps2cc.json sidecar, texture import settings and a prefab with an Animator and PS2Expressions (blendshapes by name).
